purpose: Frozen secondary analysis of completed M4 known-ground-truth outputs for anatomy heterogeneity, quartile enrichment, blind spots, comparator failures, and durable pointwise evidence preservation.

frozen_case_metrics.quartile_enrichment: median known error among top score quartile minus median known error among bottom score quartile
frozen_case_metrics.blind_spot: known_error >= case 75th percentile AND method_score <= case 25th percentile

m5_descriptive_blind_spot_metrics.blind_spot_count: number of points satisfying the frozen blind-spot definition
m5_descriptive_blind_spot_metrics.high_error_count: number of points at or above the case 75th known-error percentile
m5_descriptive_blind_spot_metrics.blind_spot_error_median_mm: median known error among blind-spot points; NaN if none
m5_descriptive_blind_spot_metrics.blind_spot_error_max_mm: maximum known error among blind-spot points; NaN if none

aggregation.case_to_anatomy: median across valid cases within each anatomy
aggregation.anatomy_to_cohort: descriptive median and range across assessable anatomies

failure_handling.comparators: retain method-specific invalid cases and exact recorded failure reasons; do not impute or repair

durable_outputs: pointwise evidence table reconstructed directly from immutable shard checkpoints
figure_plan: anatomy-level Spearman values for all four methods
anatomy-level top-minus-bottom known-error quartile deltas for all four methods
anatomy-level blind-spot rates for all four methods
prohibited_post_result_changes: changing the frozen quartile or blind-spot thresholds
dropping weak anatomies or failed comparator cases
selecting only favorable cases for a primary figure
changing M4 primary or comparator conclusions based on M5
claim_boundary: M5 is secondary/descriptive interpretation of completed M4 evidence. It cannot convert ranking informativeness into calibration, clinical validity, external generalization, or superiority over ICE.
